recommendation: Keep the empty audit commit as-is. If future maintainers want to clean old commented or disabled ex-claimtype fragments, handle that under a targeted maintenance issue rather than FHIR-13800.
issue_request: FHIR-13800 was Published/Persuasive for STU3 FM terminology valuesets. It asked to remove "Example" from the Claim Type value set name because Claim and ExplanationOfBenefit had extensible bindings; its resolution says the work was done through tracker FHIR-13751.
initial_application: The rename was applied by historical commit 49ee52b963abadc71e75fff3c1f5e31e86d25d30, "Tracker #13751 related", which changed valueset-claim-type.xml from "Example Claim Type Codes" to "Claim Type Codes", removed sample/example wording, and changed the included system from ex-claimtype to claim-type.
additional_context: FHIR-13751 is the directly related Published/Persuasive follow-up to FHIR-13614 and records the broader decision to use Claim Type codes extensibly in Claim, ClaimResponse, and ExplanationOfBenefit. Current source/fhir.ini keeps those resources active, and their type bindings reference http://hl7.org/fhir/ValueSet/claim-type. A source-wide search found no remaining "Example Claim Type" wording; the only legacy ex-claimtype URL hits are not the value-set name and are in an XML-commented Communication placeholder and a disabled ProcessRequest file.
reconciliation: No source change was made. source/claim/valueset-claim-type.xml currently has name ClaimTypeCodes, title Claim Type Codes, description "This value set includes Claim Type codes.", and includes http://terminology.hl7.org/CodeSystem/claim-type, satisfying the requested rename.

related_jiras.note: Published/Persuasive follow-up that implemented the Claim Type value set rename and related claim-type URL/binding updates cited by FHIR-13800's resolution.
Earlier Published typo report that led to the follow-up discussion about Example Claim Type Codes versus binding strength.
